neighbours.label: a modifier for a thing's condition or history (used, new, dead, stale) rather than its kind
fire: The store buys used furniture and rare stamps.
The compost bin is full of dead leaves and coffee grounds.
He sells new tires from a small garage.
She removed the spoiled milk and moldy cheese from the fridge.
The chef seared raw tuna on a hot pan.
Pour melted butter over the popcorn.
They collect discarded bottles along the beach.
Soak the beans in lukewarm water overnight.
quiet: The store buys wooden furniture and foreign stamps.
The compost bin is full of oak leaves and coffee grounds.
He sells truck tires from a small garage.
She removed the soy milk and Swiss cheese from the fridge.
The chef seared yellowfin tuna on a heavy pan.
Pour plenty of butter over the popcorn.
They collect glass bottles along the beach.
Soak the beans in a bowl overnight.

notes: Written as the shared pattern behind the card's list, tested on new words (spoiled, melted, discarded). Near misses put a kind or material word in the same slot.
